review_questions.question: Does exact-final B3D32 closure of the restricted TCD-025 parent remove the earlier global completeness blocker?
review_questions.counter_hypothesis: TCD-025 was the last material parent blocker, so B3 may now be effectively complete.
review_questions.reason: B3D32 closes only the restricted TCD-025 parent scope. RG05K still explicitly records b3_complete=false and the global canonical queue is not recomputed. Later TCD-042 routing also shows unresolved admission work.

review_questions.question: Can exact-final B3I10 routing be treated as a TCD-042-B1 scientific admission?
review_questions.counter_hypothesis: A qualified child-routing decision may be sufficient to include the B1 correction in the composed B3 set.
review_questions.reason: B3I10 explicitly records child_admitted_here=false, parent_tcd_admitted=false, and routes B1 to a separate bounded admission decision. Routing authority is not admission authority.

review_questions.question: Can the seeded or staging B3D33 branches be treated as current scientific authority?
review_questions.counter_hypothesis: The existence of B3D33 authoring/freeze/review branches indicates the next admission is practically complete and may be anticipated.
review_questions.reason: The canonical B3D33 branch remains exactly at the B3I10 seed head and has no B3D33 status artifact at that observed head. Noncanonical staging branches are active work, not qualified scientific authority. This review does not mutate or consume them.

review_questions.question: Could post-RG05K exact-final B3D31/B3D32 authorities make the aggregate's b3_complete=false flag administratively stale rather than scientifically decisive?
review_questions.counter_hypothesis: The aggregate has simply not caught up with later admissions, while the effective scientific set may already be complete.
review_questions.reason: A positive whole-B3 completeness authority requires explicit reconciliation and global queue recomputation. Post-aggregate advances cannot be inferred into a whole-model composition claim, especially while TCD-042 B1 remains unadmitted.

review_questions.question: Could bounded parent compositions such as B3D27 or B3D32 be composed transitively into a whole-B3 authority without a separate global record?
review_questions.counter_hypothesis: If each difficult parent has its own qualified composition, global composition may follow by aggregation.
review_questions.reason: B3Q01 requires a separate composition record and qualification. Local parent composition does not establish cross-parent non-interference, overlap, cancellation masking, ordering, interaction coverage or uncertainty propagation for the whole B3 object.

review_questions.question: Could a whole-B3 composition authority already exist under another live branch name?
review_questions.counter_hypothesis: The naming convention may not include B3COMP or composition, so absence from the expected branch is inconclusive.
review_questions.reason: Fresh live composition branch search finds only B3COMP work and bounded parent-composition branches B3D27/B3D32. The validator also fails on later RG05, B3D and B3I authority numbers. This supports fail-closed negative status but is not a claim that every possible branch name has been independently audited.

review_questions.question: Does concurrent B3D33 work make this negative authority unsafe to close now?
review_questions.counter_hypothesis: Any active concurrent workstream should prevent a scientific authority from being issued.
review_questions.reason: The authority is explicitly scoped to the pinned current qualified state. Final CI must fail if the canonical B3D33 branch advances, or if any B3D34+, B3I11+ or RG05L+ authority appears. Thus concurrent work is observed without being overwritten or anticipated.

required_future_recheck: Any movement of canonical B3D33, any later B3 admission/routing/aggregate authority, or any newly qualified whole-B3 composition object invalidates reuse of this live-state conclusion and requires a fresh completeness audit.
